{
  "metadata": {
    "send_date": "1932-04-16",
    "letter_title": null,
    "sender_persons": ["John Doe"],
    "receiver_persons": ["Jane Doe", "Johnny Doe"]
  },
  "content": "Dear Jane and Johnny,

I hope this letter finds you both in good health and spirits. I am writing to inform you about a recent event that I believe will be of great interest to you both.

As you may know, I have been involved in the local community theater for many years now. We have recently decided to put on a production of 'Romeo and Juliet' and I have been cast in the role of Romeo. I am thrilled about this opportunity and I hope that you will both be able to attend the performance.

The show will be taking place on Friday, May 20th at 7:00 PM at the community center. Tickets are available now and I have enclosed two for you both. Please let me know if you need any additional information.

I look forward to seeing you both at the show!

Best regards,
John"
}

Best regards,
